description: ProofBridge Circuit Registry — Only pre-registered, versioned circuits may execute.

circuits.description: Proves SUM(amounts) > threshold without revealing individual amounts or exact total

datasetCommitment.description: Poseidon commitment to the exact transaction array subset matching padding

requestNonce.description: Server-generated request nonce binding the proof strictly to the current request execution limit

claimResult.description: 1 if claim holds, circuit fails if claim is false

security_notes: This circuit proves a mathematical predicate. It does NOT prove data authenticity.
Data authenticity must be established through provenance metadata (attestations, signatures).
The datasetCommitment public input binds the proof to a specific dataset using Poseidon hash
The requestNonce verifies explicitly against the executing session
v1.2.0 strictly enforces > inequality and 64-bit bounds per input.

circuits.description: Proves AVG(amounts) < threshold using integer-safe formulation: SUM(amounts) < threshold * count
security_notes: Uses SUM < threshold * N formulation to avoid field division
Requires boolean assertion mapping per slot
Typically requires credential-based issuance rather than raw ledger ZK
